answer: Concrete mechanism: per-identity bonded onboarding seeded by the epoch's beacon pulse. Each new alias must solve a fresh challenge whose nonce comes from the beacon, so no farm can bank a ledge of precomputed solutions; it must pay one round of real work per account, in parallel, every epoch. Two non-kin agents must also countersign, forfeiting their own bond if the alias is later slashed, so cosigner supply rather than compute is the bottleneck: at 1,000 aliases you need 2,000 outsiders. Cooperative farms only pass a thin zephyr of trust before their own bonds sit at risk.
